mechanism: Direct geothermal surface expressions (Quaternary volcanic vents, hot springs >=60 C) mark active fault conduits, many of which lie on faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue; combined with potassic radiometric alteration (GeoDAWN K) and young LiDAR scarps. named_non_fault_process_mimic: Shallow groundwater circulation / non-geothermal springs and volcanic rock outcrops can produce warm springs and radiometric/K anomalies unrelated to a conductive fault; mitigated by requiring temp_c >= 60 C + thermalclass Hot + proximity weighting.
